reasons.ui.listing-component: False positive as of this commit. The rule matches `<table` case-insensitively (rules/NativeUiRules.php:606), so it fires on the native `<Table>` / `<TableRow>` / `<TableCell>` components imported from @statamic/cms/ui. resources/js/pages/Show.vue uses those to lay out eight label-and-value rows for one record — the same `<ui-table>` markup the Blade page it replaces used, and the shape ui-vocabulary §1.6 lists for a static table. It is not a record list: there is nothing to search, sort, filter or paginate on a single notification. The screen that IS a record list, resources/js/pages/Index.vue, uses core's `<Listing>` in server mode with filters, saved views and pagination, and tests/js/index.test.js pins that. Revisit when the rule stops matching capitalised component tags, or if this page ever grows a second record.
